name: WorldModelBench
summary: 评测视频世界模型指令遵循、时序一致性和物理规则遵循情况。
summaryEn: Evaluates instruction following, temporal coherence and physical-law adherence in video world models.
scaleZh: 350 个提示；7 个领域、56 个子领域
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 测试提示与生成视频评测协议，不是动作对齐训练轨迹库；评判器存在误差。
wmNoteEn: A prompt set and generated-video evaluation protocol, not an action-aligned trajectory corpus; judge errors remain possible.

evidence.statement: The benchmark explicitly tests video world models for temporal/common-sense violations and adherence to physical laws, alongside instruction following, using released multimodal prompts and a defined judging protocol.
